Declining the setup offer leaves the pro: declining the offer writes no config and seeds no sidecar
Accepting the setup offer runs the same: accepting runs the connect flow: config + handoff + sidecar appear
Connecting github writes config and prin: writes github provider + target and prints the App/PAT handoff
Connecting linear writes config and prin: writes linear provider + team and prints the Arcade handoff
Re-connecting a different provider leave: re-connecting a different provider leaves no stale provider
The credential is stored in the keychain: stores the token in the secret store and never writes it to config or output
Verification passes and the connection i: reports the connection live when verification passes
Verification fails and names the missing: reports not connected and names the missing piece: %s
A verified connect seeds an empty tracke: seeds an empty tracker-map sidecar on a verified connect
A failed verification does not seed the: does not seed the sidecar when verification fails
Accepting the pollution opt-ins writes b: writes both pollution opt-in files when accepted
Declining the pollution opt-ins writes n: writes neither pollution opt-in file when declined
Connecting an unsupported provider perfo: rejects an unsupported provider with no config, secret, or sidecar
